title: The normalized separator corners stay positive at half-bandwidth 3 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, divide each Schur row on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` by its diagonal. The normalized corner from 1 to 8 lies strictly between `1/10^50` and `1/10^49`. The normalized corner from 8 to 1 lies strictly between `1/10^221` and `1/10^220`.
- In survivor order those corners have distance 3. Every other survivor pair at distance greater than 2 is an exact zero before and after the positive row scaling, so the half-bandwidth is 3.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized Schur section, not an all-size bandwidth theorem.
